scientific_scope_status: On a supplied finite directed stochastic network P with local row/coordinate access, unit phases x_v update at rate one by x_v<-y x_w, w~P(v,.), using a single Brownian circle phase y with generator gamma partial_theta^2. The exact local identity L(x_v y^k)=-(1+gamma k^2)x_v y^k+sum_w P_vw x_w y^(k+1) gives h_v=sum_n y^n(P^n x)_v/product_(j=0)^n(1+gamma j^2). The source proves the generator-domain and integrated-transient interpretation, not merely a formal series. For 0<gamma<=1, response is O(gamma^-1/3), sharp on the one-site positive instance. A rational block-geometric evaluator uses O(gamma^-1/3) expected local row calls with O(gamma^-2/3) second moment, and a specified local-query lower bound matches this per-sample scale.
